notes: cics-crucible ghost-tasks / gt-send-text-terminal (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): SEND TEXT ... TERMINAL: the default output disposition, the task's principal facility -- the typing terminal for a terminal task, the START TERMID terminal for a started one; nothing for a task with none. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: terminal-and-started
scenarios.why: SEND TEXT with and without TERMINAL record the same event; a task started at T001 sends to T001; a task with no terminal (ASSIGN FACILITY INVREQ) sends nothing
